info.name: WSO2 API Manager - Admin Advanced Policy (Collection) Advanced Policy (Collection) SDKs API
Generate a SDK for an API

params.name: apiId
params.description: **API ID** consisting of the **UUID** of the API.

params.name: language
params.description:
Programming language of the SDK that is required.

Languages supported by default are **Java**, **Javascript**, **Android** and **JMeter**.

items.docs: This operation can be used to generate SDKs (System Development Kits), for the APIs available in the API Developer Portal, for a requested development language.

info.name: Get a List of Supported SDK Languages

items.docs: This operation will provide a list of programming languages that are supported by the swagger codegen library for generating System Development Kits (SDKs) for APIs available in the API Manager Developer Portal
